The Society for Military History
Distinguished Book Awards for 2027
Background : The Society for Military History is soliciting nominations for its annual Distinguished Book Awards for 2027. Established in 1933, the Society is devoted to stimulating and advancing the study of military history. Its membership (today more than 2,600) includes many of the most prominent scholars, soldiers, and citizens interested in military history. The Society encourages research and publication across the whole range of military history (ancient, medieval, and modern, including related popular studies). The Society publishes The Journal of Military History , the leading international scholarly journal of military history. The Distinguished Book Awards : For the 2027 awards, books published (copyright date) in 2025 and 2026 are eligible. Works previously nominated for the Society’s book awards may be resubmitted provided they were first published no earlier than 2025. Nominated books should be assigned to one of the following prize categories :
Distinguished Book ( two awards for the best books overall, regardless of geographical focus)
Edited and Reference Book (works containing collections of information, such as anthologies, diaries, dictionaries, encyclopedias, atlases, handbooks, and diagnostic manuals)
Biography and Memoirs (works that examine the life of a single individual or the lives of multiple individuals; or first-person accounts of lived experiences in the context of war and/or the military)
First Book (works that represent a single author’s first monograph) The committee will make its selections for awards by January 30, 2027. The Society will give the awards at its annual meeting in New Orleans on March 11-14, 2027. The author of each prize-winning book will receive recognition at the Society’s annual awards presentation and a $1000 prize. Books submitted to the Committee for consideration for the 2027 awards must be postmarked by October 1, 2026 . Publishers must follow this process for each volume they intend to submit: For each book to be considered, please complete this Google form and send a copy of each book to each committee member at the addresses listed below. Books must be submitted in physical copy, and electronic versions will not be considered. The Committee recognizes the expense to authors and publishers associated with submitting five copies of each nominated book and therefore encourages serious submissions only. Please note that books will not be returned and that only award winners will be notified of selection. At the discretion of the Committee submissions which are received after October 1, 2026, may be deferred for consideration in the 2028 awards. Sincerely, Marion (Molly) Girard Dorsey Chair SMH Book Awards Committee Email: marion.girard.dorsey@unh.edu .
